messages:
olivia: Heads-up — planning a version bump on main to v1.15.0 in ~2 hours. Cutoff for critical fixes is 60m. Need someone to confirm branch creation + signing flow.

matt: I have one infra backport PR that might land. Low risk. Will hold if it touches packaging.

anya: @matt if that PR changes the packaging pipeline, please don't merge until after I create the release branch. I'll cut release/1.15 right before the bump.

jordan: I'll assemble the draft release notes. Can anyone confirm whether we want the new batching flag mentioned in the top-level changes or under 'internal'? I think top-level.

sami: Who's doing the GPG tag signing? I can sign but need the signing host access and passphrase. If not possible, we should have a fallback plan.

release-bot: [auto-check] CI status: all checks passed; builds: 3/3; checksums generated: yes; signatures: missing

olivia: Thanks release-bot. @sami if signing will be delayed >30m, fallback is to push an unsigned tag and follow up with a signed annotated tag later. Legal asked to review quantized binary export notes — @jordan please link the export-control blurb in the draft.

sami: I'm available. @eng-infra-bot can you open a 1-hour window to the signing host (signer-01)? I will run: ```gpg --detach-sign -u release@redwood -o v1.15.sig v1.15.0.tar.gz``` and push the signed tag.

eng-infra-bot: Request received. Please add a comment in infra-requests with the signing window times. Access will be provisioned for 60 minutes after approval.

matt: Reminder: branch naming convention is release/<semver>. Also we need to freeze changelog merging into main until after the tag is pushed, to avoid drift.

anya: I'll cut release/1.15 and create a protected branch. Once tag is signed and pushed, I'll enable the branch protections and merge the bump PR.

jordan: Draft release: adding migration note for batching opt, highlight Dedicated rollout instructions, link to changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog#v1.15.0. Also adding checksum table and a note that signed artifacts are required for enterprise installs.

olivia: Quick checklist for whoever merges the bump: 1) update pkg/version.go 2) update changelog header 3) run make release-artifacts 4) disable docs auto-deploy for 10m 5) set rollback tag prefix 'rollback-1.15-<ts>'

sami: Signed tag created locally: `git tag -s v1.15.0 -m "v1.15.0 signed release"` — requesting push perms to push the tag.

eng-infra-bot: Pushing tags permitted for users in group 'release-maintainers' for this window. Confirm group membership and proceed.

matt: I can push if needed. @sami if you hand over the tag object I can push under release account to avoid SSH passphrase prompts.

sami: Pushed signed tag to origin. Command: `git push origin refs/tags/v1.15.0` — please verify.

release-bot: [auto-check] signature verification: OK; tag v1.15.0 present; draft release created at https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/tag/v1.15.0; artifacts uploaded: 3 files.

anya: Branch release/1.15 created and protected. Merging version bump now.

matt: Starting release pipeline (staging -> canary -> prod). I'll monitor latency/telemetry for the first 15 minutes.

olivia: If any hotfixes land after cutoff, label them 'post-cutoff' and I'll coordinate cherry-picks to release/1.15 with a patch bump. Reminder to QA: run the regression set for quantization and KV-cache.

jordan: Added export-control note and checksum table to the draft. Also added a short 'how to rollback' section using the rollback tag prefix.

olivia: Publishing now. :rocket:

release-bot: [auto] publish started. Monitoring artifact distribution.

release-bot: [auto] publish complete. Artifacts available: s3://releases.redwood/v1.15.0/* ; checksums verified.

olivia: Published and announced. Closing the loop — thanks everyone. :tada:
